observationsNotFindings: This is the third artifact of its exact shape I have reviewed in this sweep, after the component-manifest windows-path input corpus and the SARIF preview advertisement table, and the family discipline is holding well. Each names classes verbatim from a live source, expands them into per-class entries carrying NOT-AUTHORED, asserts no register token, and refuses the adjacent temptation by name. The pattern is easy to audit precisely because the authored content is almost entirely quotation.

Reproducing reservedNumbersRemainReserved as a whole four-key object rather than as a list of labels is the strongest choice in the file. It is the hardest form of quotation to fake and the easiest to check, and it keeps all four reservations legible - including the OD-112-4 distinction that the waiver is expiry-bearing and explicitly 'not a number' - without supplying a single value.

The catalog sits adjacent to the recovery-ceremony cell of the live DR-112 row: it names air-gap and removable-media classes, which are exactly the presentation media a ceremony would use. It declines the ceremony three times and supplies nothing. Worth noting because the proximity is where a later fixture-authoring cycle is most likely to drift.

Both of this artifact's review pins are single-reviewer, and DR-112's design standing more broadly now rests on Claude-only acceptances at the G08 harness, the leftover join, and this catalog. Nothing here overstates - each pin says 'Codex not reviewed' - but the aggregate is only visible from the coordinator's position.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: No blockers, no should-fix. The artifact is almost entirely quotation and both quoted structures check exactly. namedCorpusNotAuthored equals live G08 v2's four classes under ==, and it independently equals the namedCorpusNotAuthored carried on OBL-G08-FX-AUTHORING in the live leftover join, so the naming verifies from two directions. reservedNumbersRemainReserved is dict-equal to live G08 v2 across all four OD-112 keys with identical values - the hardest quotation in the file to fake and the easiest to check. The classes array is that four-item list expanded rather than a second drifting list: ids and memberVerbatim both equal it in order, key sets are uniform, and all four carry fixtureBytes NOT-AUTHORED. I tested the reserved-number prohibition by sweeping for values rather than reading the denials, and none exists - the only bare integers are 0, 1, 26 and the 08 path segment. The recovery ceremony is refused three times and supplied nothing, which matters because this catalog names air-gap and removable-media, the very media a ceremony would use. Both obligations it declines to close are live and still open in the join. Two notes rather than findings: the absent file 08 status token matches the authored-catalog convention rather than the leftover-join one, so there is no conflict with the live OPEN row; and both of this artifact's review pins are single-reviewer with no Codex, one of them my own verdict from earlier in this session, so my confirmation of those standings is not independent - though the catalog's correctness rests on G08 v2's bytes, which I compared directly. 18 attacks run, 18 refuted.
